## 1. Overview & Trip Highlights

Unleash your inner shopper in Kutch. Explore our guide to buying authentic Rogan art, Ajrakh block prints, mirror-work embroidery, copper bells, and local leather craft. Rann Utsav is a magnificent festival celebrating the white salt desert of Kutch. It brings together local crafts, folk music, adventure sports, and premium tent accommodations under one roof.

### Key Travel Highlights
* **Top Attraction**: Rogan Art Nirona - Exclusive castor-oil based painting on silk fabrics, practiced by only one family in Nirona.
* **Scenic Landmark**: Ajrakh Block Printing - Traditional woodblock printing using natural dyes in geometric patterns.
* **Cultural Focus**: Kutchi Embroidery - Bibrant thread work with embedded mirrors, done by local Rabari and Ahir women.
